title: ChalkScript explainer document, version 1.x
description: The structure and types of an explainer document (docs/format/explainer-1.0.md). Expressions are strings; a reader parses them and resolves references, which this schema does not.

profile.description: The style profile the document is made for; open when absent.

appearances.description: The appearances the document is made for; without it, both.

colours.description: Colours the document names for itself: a value for each appearance the document is made for, or a suggested colour of its profile, and a cue. That the values match the appearances is a finding of the reader.

number.description: A number, or an expression that gives one.

truth.description: A truth value, or an expression that gives one.

value.description: A number, a truth value, or an expression.

selection.description: An expression that gives a selection.
